notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 Released!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27208672/6e9d32fba07b166d67e0616cf996fc7c7826bc35.png[/img]

[h1]Heroes![/h1]

We've been taking on board your feedback from the launch of Vermintide VR - Hero Trials, and have put together our first patch for the game this festive season:

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[*]Added a "Render Quality Scale" in the in-game menu. The higher the value, the sharper the image. Higher values require a better graphics card.
[*]Tweaked amount of ragdolls on high setting.
[*]The Skaven now stand closer to players, making the rapier more useful.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27208672/2bba1d5ad6266eb8f33a69dcc14cb671487ece89.png[/img]

notes.title: Vermintide VR - Hero Trials has launched!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27208672/29495195d03a8cc88b1d54ee6ffb04aec7f68da2.png[/img]

[h1]Heroes![/h1]

[i]Welcome to Vermintide VR - Hero Trials![/i]

Step into the Warhammer Fantasy world like never before in this short and fun (and absolutely FREE!) VR experience. As an aspiring hero, you need to prove your worth by outsmarting the cunning Skaven, using your expert marksmanship and keen melee skills. 

[b]For the Empire![/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27208672/2bba1d5ad6266eb8f33a69dcc14cb671487ece89.png[/img]

[h1]Post Launch[/h1]

We are aware of some questions that have been posed, and issues that have been reported in the last day since launch and would like to talk about those.

- [b]It's very short![/b]: This is a short free VR experience, no doubt, but the same love we have poured in to Warhammer: Vermintide has gone in to bringing to life the man-size rat-men! We're just dipping our toes in to the VR scene and wanted to share with you what we learn as we learn it!

- [b]HMD Support[/b]: At this time we only have support for the HTC Vive but we are looking to add additional support for alternate HMDs in the future. Alternate HMDs have not been tested on and as such are prone to encounter some issues, such as inversion, switched hands

- [b]It's blurry, Fatshark![/b]: Possible, yes. You can (hardware depending) increase a value in the "settings.ini" file (found in /steam/common/warhammer end times VR/bundle). Open the document in notepad or similar, and look to the bottom of the list and find: "vr_target_scale = 0.8". Try setting it to "1".

- [b]What's the Advanced CPU setting?[/b]: Enable this only if you have a recent i7 processor or equivalent. This is the first option to disable if your experience is sluggish.

- [b]It's not performing quite right![/b]: Please check that you at least meet the minimum specifications outlined on the Store page:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/410390
